ECOU

Turn any sound into a playable instrument. Capture it, resynthesize it, and shape it with camera, motion and real acoustic space.

Audio starts on your first tap. On iPhone, disable silent mode.

ECOU

Smart Keys
Autoplay

Tap a loop to start it on the next bar. Tap an empty cell to record into it, or hold a loop for more options.

Capture

Record or import a short source — a tapped glass, a sung note, a creaking door. Ecou maps it across the keyboard.

Live inputoff

Play guitar, bass or vocals live through the insert chain — turn on the Amp module in Mix. Use headphones. Expect some latency on Android.

For best results, record 20–30 cm from the mic: one clean hit or a sustained note. Silence is trimmed, gain normalized and the root note detected automatically. Video files are accepted — the audio track is used.

Voice charactersspeak-style, on sound A

Record your voice into A, then pick a character. Robot and Vocoder chord turn speech into a playable synth; the others reshape it. Play it on the keys or use Record to pad.

Instrument

Sound librarytap to load on this track

Multisampled instruments made on your phone — no downloads. Basses play mono with glide; tweak below or record your own sound in Capture.

Describe the sound

FM voice
Tine Piano

DX7-compatible 6-operator FM. Import single voices or 32-voice banks. Sound Match turns the sound in Capture slot A into an editable FM voice that also plays on an FM-1.

Glass TapChoir Pad

Crossfade: both sources play, mixed by level.

Timbre transfer keeps A’s pitch and articulation and paints it with B’s spectral envelope. Spectral blend interpolates both spectra frame by frame (B is pitch-aligned and time-stretched to A). Both re-render a new source when you move the slider.

MIDI inputnot connected

USB or Bluetooth controllers (Chrome). Velocity, pitch bend (±2 st) and mod wheel are supported — the mod wheel is a source in the mod matrix.

M-VAVE FM-1not connected
Play tracks on the FM-1

0 = Ecou plays it. 1–16 = the notes go to that FM-1 MIDI channel instead (FM-1 Open: channels 1–7 = tracks 1–7, 10 = track 8; V16: each Voice's receive channel).


      
FM-1 setup (firmware, effect channel)
        

        
        
Effect CCs: V16 uses CC 70–93, V15 uses CC 0–23, both on the Effect channel. Keep the Effect channel different from the voice channels.

      
FM-1 effects (remote)

      
FM-1 voices 1–8 (V16 multitimbral)
Set each Voice's MIDI Ch on the FM-1 to match. Preset sends Program Change; Level sends Expression (CC 11) on that channel.

        

      
Motion → FM-1 (phone, camera, pads)
Tilt the phone, wave at the camera or drag the XY pad to play the FM-1's filter, effects or expression. Enable Motion or Camera on the Mod tab first.

      
Record the FM-1 into Ecou (USB audio)
Over USB the FM-1 is also an audio input. Choose it here, then use Capture or an armed audio track as usual: FM-1 sounds become Ecou samples and Sound Match sources.

        

      
USB: Chrome on Android (USB-C/OTG) or desktop. Bluetooth: Chrome connects to the FM-1 directly, no pairing app needed. For playing FM-1 keys into Ecou without double sound, set LOCAL off on the FM-1 (MIDI ROUTING page).

Grid

        
        

        
100% = exactly on the grid. 50–80% keeps some of your feel. Drums sit on 1/16 steps, so triplets apply to the melodic layers only. Undo with ↶ Undo take.

      AI Beatbox → kit
      
Beatbox a groove (up to 8 s). Ecou slices every hit, classifies it as kick, snare, hat or perc, loads the best take of each onto the pads, detects the tempo and writes the pattern into the sequencer.

Export timeline

      

      
Rendered offline from bar 1 to the end of the last clip, with automation. Stems in Mix → Export use the timeline whenever it has clips.

    

    

      
Recording

      
      
      
Recordings are aligned automatically using the reported input and output latency. If takes still land early or late on this device, nudge the offset. With a multichannel interface, give each armed track its own input (In 1, In 2 or Stereo) and record them together. In a loop, every pass becomes a take.

      
Bluetooth headphones: while the mic is open, Android switches them to call mode (muffled, mono). Record with wired headphones or the phone speaker; Ecou releases the mic the moment recording stops.
